# Every icon name Notion's built-in picker can put on a page, database or
# callout — the values the API returns as {"type":"icon","icon":{"name":…}}.
#
# Notion publishes no list (its API reference gives examples only, and the
# picker's catalogue lives in a chunk the login bundle never loads), so this
# was gathered against Notion's own icon files, which are public and named
# after the icon:
#
#     https://www.notion.so/icons/<name>_<color>.svg   200 = real, 404 = not
#
# Candidates came from Anytype's own 390 icon names, the icon vocabularies of
# Material Symbols and Lucide, the names a real workspace's export used, and
# Notion's shipped UI chunks; then two rounds of variants (-alternate, -line,
# -filled, plurals, head words) until a round returned nothing new.
#
# Refresh: re-run the sweep and diff against this file. Anything new needs a
# line in notionIconNames (and, if its Anytype target is new, in
# notionIconEmoji) — TestEveryNotionIconResolves fails until it has one.
